about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm currently pursuing a degree in Computer Engineering at UNLaM and graduated as an IT Technician. My education has given me a solid foundation in programming, systems analysis, and software development.
about.p2: I'm interested in contributing to projects where I can combine technical skills with organization, testing, and teamwork. I enjoy learning new technologies and taking on challenges that help me grow professionally.
